notes.title: OFFICIALLY FREE TO PLAY!!
notes.notes:
[b]As promised in our last announcement, [i]Lilith Was Dead[/i] is now FREE TO PLAY!![/b]

You can download and play [i]Lilith Was Dead[/i] [b]for free[/b], right this very moment! Crazy, I know!

We are very happy to make this announcement as we want as many people as possible to experience our fun little creation that we worked hard to make.

Now, instead of reading this Steam announcement post any longer, go give [i]Lilith Was Dead[/i] a try if you haven't already! We hope our short visual novel can give you some joy :)

Best,
The HWG Team

notes.title: Going Free to Play!
notes.notes:
[b][i]Lilith Was Dead [/i]will be going free to play as soon as possible![/b]

As soon as approval is finished, you can now download and play the full game for free! Check back for another announcement soon to be informed when we officially go free to play. It should hopefully be within a week from today!

We are deciding to go free to play as we want as many people as possible to experience the game, and the initial goal with [i]Lilith Was Dead[/i] was never to make money. 

We hope you are all excited about this development, and we hope to see more people experience the story of [i]Lilith Was Dead[/i]!
